沿用现有远端采集路径；当前不提供路径覆盖。: Uses the existing remote data location. Path overrides are not available yet.
已有任务运行方式过滤规则已保留，暂停会同时暂停该服务器的兼容采集。: Existing runtime filters are retained. Pausing also pauses compatible collection for this server.
未找到 ZCode 任务数据库；桌面项目可单独读取，保留上次任务状态: The ZCode task database was not found. Desktop projects can still be listed. Previous task state is retained.
ZCode 任务数据库暂被占用；保留上次任务状态: The ZCode task database is busy. Previous task state is retained.
ZCode 任务数据库无法读取或格式不兼容；保留上次任务状态: The ZCode task database could not be read or uses an incompatible format. Previous task state is retained.
Hermes 旧版数据库仅提供会话信息，无法确认当前执行状态: This Hermes database only provides session information. Current execution status cannot be verified.
读取异常会保留上次状态，不会当作任务结束。: Read failures retain the last state and never imply task completion.
tmux 是任务运行方式，现有兼容配置继续保留。: tmux is a task runtime. Existing compatible configuration is retained.
使用系统 SSH Key，任务数据保存在本机: System SSH keys, locally stored task data
关闭窗口前，请处理未保存的编辑。: Resolve unsaved changes before closing the window.
这会修改所选 Claude 配置。已有 Hook、代理和模型设置会保留，首次修改: This modifies the selected Claude configuration. Existing hooks, proxy and model settings are preserved and the first change is backed up.
请在 TaskPulse 桌面应用中打开监控来源。: Open monitoring sources in the TaskPulse desktop app.
监控配置已在其他窗口更新，请加载最新配置。: Monitoring configuration changed in another window. Load the latest configuration.
请先应用或取消当前编辑。: Apply or cancel your current edits first.
读取完成，请查看来源状态: Read completed. Check the source status.
读取失败，已保留上次状态: Read failed. Last known state retained.
读取未完成，已保留上次状态: Read incomplete. Last known state retained.
目录来自已采集会话，不会导入完整历史或补发通知。: The catalog contains observed sessions. It does not import full history or replay notifications.
移除会停止此服务器的采集，并按现有范围规则移出其任务；不会修改远端文件。: Removal stops collection and removes this server’s tasks from scope under the existing rules. Remote files are unchanged.
tmux 不在监控范围: tmux is outside the monitoring scope
项目不在监控范围: Project is outside the monitoring scope
统一管理本机 Agent 与 SSH 服务器，重要任务一目了然。: Manage local agents and SSH servers, and see which tasks need you.
无法打开系统浏览器，请复制项目链接后重试: Could not open the system browser. Copy the project link and try again.
打开项目链接未完成: The project link could not be opened.
移除会停止采集，不会修改 Agent 配置。: Removing stops collection without changing Agent configuration.
原生读取与匹配解除尚未适配: Native reading and correlated resolution are not supported yet
Qoder IDE 与 CLI 的 Hook 不同；当前不提供自动采集。可使用“: Qoder IDE and CLI have different Hooks. Automatic collection is not supported. Use Other agents (standard events) for manual integration; the producer must correlate turns and requests.
仅发现正在运行的进程；不识别审批、提问或任务结束。: Discovers running processes only; cannot detect approvals, questions or turn completion.
只读 Kimi 原生 wire 日志；能力随日志版本而异。: Reads native Kimi wire journals. Capabilities depend on the journal version.
只读 Qoder Desktop 轮次投影及 IDE/CLI 转录；原生审批和提: Reads Qoder Desktop turn projections and IDE/CLI transcripts. Native approval and question reminders are not supported.
公开会话发现；当前非标准会话库的任务状态读取受限。: Public session discovery only. Task state cannot currently be read from the nonstandard session store.
来源明确报告本轮失败: The source reported a failed turn
Trae 的任务库尚不能直接读取。可在已发现会话中查看目录，任务进度与提醒暂不可: Trae’s task database cannot be read directly. Check Discovered sessions for catalog entries. Task progress and reminders are unavailable.
Claude Code 有新活动后会自动更新，旧会话不会当作运行中的任务。: New Claude Code activity appears automatically. Old sessions are kept out of running tasks.
用于让 Agent 或脚本主动发送任务开始、结束或请求等通知。需要在发送端单独配: Connect an agent or script that sends task starts, completions, or requests. Set up the sender separately.
等待首条任务通知: Waiting for the first task event
通过进程和终端窗口识别 Gemini CLI 等工具的活动。无法确认审批、提问或: Detects activity from processes and terminal windows, including Gemini CLI. It cannot confirm approvals, questions or task completion.
Hook 是这个 Agent 的可选事件来源，需要单独在宿主中配置。: Hooks are an optional event source for this agent and require separate setup in the host.
此来源中未记录项目路径的会话: Sessions in this source without a recorded project path
只看 Gemini CLI 等程序是否正在运行，无法判断任务进度、审批或结果。上: Checks whether tools such as Gemini CLI are running. It cannot tell whether a task is progressing, waiting for approval, or finished. Tools listed above usually do not need it.
上方的本机工具不用再连接。只有能主动发送任务状态的其他工具，才需要在这里添加。: You do not need to connect the local tools listed above. Use this section for other tools that can send their own task updates.
开启这个连接并应用更改: Turn on this connection and apply changes
可以把上方的来源名称改成你要连接的工具名。: You can rename the source above to match the tool you are connecting.
到对方工具里完成设置: Set up the connection in the other tool
支持本机 MCP（stdio）：生成并复制配置，把 taskpulse 条目加到: If the tool supports local MCP (stdio), generate and copy the configuration. Add the taskpulse entry to its existing MCP settings and reload them. Tools that accept only remote URLs cannot use this configuration.
确认对方能发来状态: Check that the tool can send updates
在对方工具里确认能找到 taskpulse_report，再用下方示例测试。连接: Find taskpulse_report in the other tool and test it with the example below. The tool still needs to send updates when tasks start or end.
打开此连接的开关并应用更改后，即可生成配置。: Turn on this connection and apply changes to generate the configuration.
让对方调用 taskpulse_report，传入以下参数。这个测试不会创建任务: Call taskpulse_report in the other tool with these arguments. This test does not create a task.
使用脚本发送任务状态: Send task updates from a script
如果对方能用脚本发出任务状态，导出命令和示例，在真实任务事件发生时把 JSON: If the tool can send updates from a script, export the command and example. Pass JSON to the command when an actual task event occurs.
TaskPulse 不会自动读取对方的聊天。工具没有本机 MCP，也不能用脚本上: TaskPulse does not automatically read conversations. Skip this connection if the tool cannot report through local MCP or a script.
；本平台不提供新增 Hook 操作。可尝试通过 MCP 或脚本连接。: . Adding Hooks is unavailable here. You can try connecting through MCP or a script.
未找到支持的豆包工作任务记录；普通聊天不在监控范围内: No supported Doubao work-task record was found. Regular chat is outside the monitoring scope.
找到多条豆包工作任务记录，无法确认当前记录: Multiple Doubao work-task records were found. The current record could not be verified.
无法确认豆包桌面端是否运行: Could not verify whether Doubao Desktop is running
暂无可读取的豆包工作任务: No readable Doubao work tasks yet
手动开启后，只关注兼容的豆包工作任务。普通聊天不在监控范围内。: Turn this source on manually to monitor compatible Doubao work tasks. Regular chats are outside the monitoring scope.
可先查看配置，再决定是否启用。: Review each source before enabling it.
